answer: Reaching the forge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the raven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
